The party left Highreach and headed toward Ardenville for the upcoming boat race.

  • Camped for the night in dense woods along the road
  • During the night, a horrific melting creature attacked the camp
  • The creature resembled a warped version of Liz — some kind of magically altered ooze
  • Party defeated it; it melted into boiling slime on death
